email.subject: WE WON (help)
email.body:
WE WON!! The newsletter needs a photo of our Gold medal by noon and the camera bot squashed all 8 photos. Coach's notes are in coach.txt, mine are in notes.txt. Roommate says grep Gold in both and open the photo it names. Same trick as the ball??

Dex

coach.txt: drills that worked: cone weave, wall passes
drills that did not: anything Leo invented
Priya = MVP. do not tell her yet
bus company still owes us a refund
newsletter wants: score, photo, one quote
quote: 'we bounced back.' keep it short
Jordan's whiteboard art is now 'team culture'
fix the pump. or hide it from Leo
Gold medal = photo 6. Ref says it's a perfect octagon, 8 equal sides.
silver last year, so this one means a lot
Sam: the camera bot is NOT a camera
thank-you card for the ref (the tall one)
keep the medal in the trophy case, not the van
next season starts Feb. rest your ankles
notes.txt: TEAM NOTES vol. 2 (Jordan STILL means you)
WE WON. this file is now a shrine
victory pizza: pineapple ban lifted for one night
Leo's gold shoes are banned from all photos
who took the cooler home
Priya says MVP is a social construct
Sam: please stop asking the camera bot nicely
bus home: 9:40, Coach means 9:20
jersey #12 found. it was on Jordan
newsletter photo due at noon!!!
photos are in this folder somewhere
thank Priya's mum for the cooler (again)
chant for next year: still bad
Leo lost the pump again
party at Sam's? ask Sam's mum first
the dog has been forgiven
keep the receipts for the fundraiser
stretch before the victory lap
last week's poster is on the fridge now
whoever reads this: grep both files - roommate

replies.right: PERFECT octagon. coach nodded TWICE. we bounced back and now it's in the newsletter.
replies.wrong_file: Message bounced back: that's not our medal.
replies.wrong_shape: Message bounced back: coach says that medal got sat on.
replies.wrong_size: Message bounced back: perfect shape, wrong size. the newsletter slot is 144 wide.

shell.grep_no_match: (nothing in that file. Coach keeps his own notes.)
